Patch 1.15.8 was a routine update patch for WoW Classic (Classic Era, Season of Discovery, Hardcore). It released on 21 October 2025. Senior Game Producer Tom Ellis provides an in-depth look at this update and patch 5.5.2 for , outlining their purpose and the reasoning behind their release.

Patch 12.0.7: Revelations is a medium patch of . It includes new story and quest content, two mini zones Val and Naigtal (Showdown), a one-boss raid called Sporefall in Harandar, and the return of the Turbulent Timeways event. The raid is the first to have a flexible Mythic difficulty, scaling for 15-25 players, to help bridge the gap between Heroic and Mythic difficulties.
Patch 12.1.0: Curse of Ula'tek is a content patch of . It includes a new zone, raid, dungeon, and world boss; in addition to new delves and housing, social, and UI updates.
